plan.disposition: Phase Matrix: External LLM Review / Mini-Plan+approval are medium+ only; this run classified small

findings.finding: deliver_as_own_pr's `finally` block runs `run_git_soft(["reset", "--hard", pre_sha], ...)` and discards the returned CompletedProcess without checking returncode. If `pre_sha` is empty (its unchecked source is layer_promotion_sweep.py:195's `rev-parse HEAD` with no returncode check) or the reset itself fails/times out, the just-created promotion commit silently remains on the iterate's own branch — the exact F11 layer-coverage hard-fail hazard this whole redesign exists to prevent.
findings.suggestion: Check the rev-parse HEAD returncode in run_layer_promotion_sweep before staging/committing; check the reset's returncode in deliver_as_own_pr and surface a loud, distinct failure. Add a regression test.

findings.finding: On commit_failed/commit_timeout, the function returns immediately without unstaging the files a prior successful `git add` staged, leaving residue in the worktree's index that could later be swept into an unrelated commit. No test covered these branches.
findings.suggestion: On commit failure, attempt a rollback to unstage before returning status="error", and add a test pinning the working tree is clean afterward.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: A found promotion ships as its own small PR, decoupled from the triggering iterate's own branch/PR. — The sweep ran AFTER the canon self-heal + outbox sweep, which already commit locally onto the same fresh worktree branch. `git push HEAD:refs/heads/<new>` transports the ENTIRE unpushed ancestry, not just the tip commit — so whenever self-heal/outbox fired in the same run as a promotion, their commits rode along into the promotion's supposedly-isolated small PR, and would duplicate-deliver when the iterate's own PR later merged the same content. FIXED: reordered the sweep to run FIRST (step 4.5), before self-heal/outbox (now 4.6/4.7/5), restoring the module's documented invariant that pre_sha equals origin/<default>'s freshly-fetched tip; new real-git regression test_layer_promotion_sweep_runs_before_selfheal_and_outbox_sweep proves it.
findings.suggestion: Reorder so the sweep's pre_sha is captured before any other step can commit on this branch, and add a real-git regression test.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: rollback_failed is always surfaced, never silent. — It was 'loud' only as a CRITICAL-prefixed stderr line + JSON warnings[] entry, but setup's exit code stays 0 regardless and SKILL.md never told the calling agent to check for it — so the one outcome meaning the promotion commit may still be on the CURRENT iterate's own branch could pass unnoticed. FIXED: SKILL.md sec B1a now explicitly instructs checking warnings[] for the CRITICAL line and manually dropping the stray commit before continuing.
findings.suggestion: Have the calling skill explicitly check for and act on rollback_failed.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: This module reuses lib.pr_delivery_host's hardening rather than a weaker hand-rolled substitute. — Every gh call omitted this repo's established --repo pinning convention (pr_delivery_host's own docstring: 'the repository is never inferred from a remote'), unlike every other gh-calling module — a real deviation that could open/merge against the wrong repo on a fork-based or multi-remote setup with no error surfaced. FIXED: added repo_identity.resolve_repo_identity-based --repo pinning on every gh call, falling back to gh's own inference when unresolvable.
findings.suggestion: Pin --repo on every gh call the way the rest of the codebase does.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: The sweep leaves no residue anywhere when delivery does not complete. — A push that succeeds but whose gh pr create then fails leaves a permanent orphan chore/layer-promotion-<sha12> branch on the remote with no PR and no cleanup path. ACCEPTED as documented debt, same class as the existing 'duplicate-PR tradeoff, accepted' note: nothing is lost or corrupted, and orphan branches never block a later retry (dedup only checks OPEN PRs) — now documented explicitly in the module docstring.
findings.suggestion: A branch-cleanup follow-up, or accept as low-severity debt (chosen).
